Ma 24 (Trong do: chi phi di vay) la dong GHI CHU nam trong ma 23, KHONG tham gia tong. Bac 2 khong the suy dieu nay tu hinh hoc - no la ngu nghia ke toan.
Ma 24 khong co so thu tu rieng, nhan nam thut vao duoi nhan cua ma 23.
Ma 70/71 (lai co ban tren co phieu) la so NHO (251/373), khong phai tien, khong co dau phan cach nghin.
Ma 60, 61, 70, 71 co duong ke DOI phia duoi.
Ma 61, 62 IN NGHIENG (so thu tu 20., 21. cung in nghieng).
Trang co dau moc do de len chu o cuoi trang, dau moc thu hai bi cat cut o le phai, va ba chu ky muc xanh kem ba o ten nguoi ky.

RANG BUOC DA THU VA BI BAC BO: 61 = bang_can_doi:420b. Cong tu choi vi hai bang dung ten cot khac nhau, va kiem lai thi rang buoc chi dung o MOT cot: nam_nay (29.134.059.074) = so_cuoi_ky cua 420b. Cot con lai KHONG tuong ung - so_dau_nam cua 420b la so du DAU KY (gach ngang), khong phai loi nhuan nam truoc (40.414.622.975). Ghi lai vi day la cai bay de dat sai: hai o bang nhau o mot cot khong co nghia hai DONG tuong duong nhau.
